keep.name: Keep
keep.description: The heart of the castle. Its level caps every other building and adds builders.

wall.name: Castle Wall
wall.description: Rings the castle grounds. Defence against sieges in a later phase.

farm.name: Farm
farm.description: Grows food. Troops will eat it once recruitment arrives.

house.name: House
house.description: Townsfolk who pay taxes in gold.

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.description: Trains soldiers. Higher levels unlock stronger troops and train faster.

storehouse.name: Storehouse
storehouse.description: Raises how much of every resource the castle can hold.

workshop.name: Siege Workshop
workshop.description: Builds siege tools: ladders, mantlets and rams for your attacks, and arrow slits, moats and boiling pitch for your walls. Higher levels unlock more tools and build faster.

academy.name: Academy
academy.description: Scholars research lasting improvements for your castle: more resources, stronger soldiers and tougher walls. One study at a time; higher levels unlock more and research faster.

banner.name: Banner Pole
banner.description: Your colours flying over the yard. A decoration: raises public order, and with it production.

garden.name: Flower Garden
garden.description: Beds of roses and herbs where the townsfolk stroll. A decoration: raises public order.

well.name: Town Well
well.description: Clean water for every household. A decoration: raises public order.

grove.name: Shady Grove
grove.description: Old trees and a quiet glade inside the walls. A decoration: raises public order.

tavern.name: Tavern
tavern.description: Ale, song and a warm hearth after a long day. A decoration: raises public order a lot.

public_order.comment: Public order = the keep's order + every decoration's order + every other building's (negative: a crowded castle). Buildings count once finished (level 1+). Production of every resource changes by per_point per point of order, from -max_penalty up to +max_bonus.

research.comment: Studies in the academy. Each level of a study adds its effects once more (negative ones shorten times or cut costs). A study needs the academy at academy_level and the studies in requires at those levels. Cost and time grow per level like buildings; each academy level above 1 researches faster.

forestry.name: Forestry
forestry.description: Woodsmen learn to fell and replant in turn.

stonecutting.name: Stonecutting
stonecutting.description: Iron wedges and better sledges for the quarrymen.

crop_rotation.name: Crop Rotation
crop_rotation.description: Fields rest in turn and give more grain.

ledgers.name: Royal Ledgers
ledgers.description: Clerks count every coin the markets owe you.

granaries.name: Great Granaries
granaries.description: Dry cellars and stout lofts hold more of everything.

drill_yards.name: Drill Yards
drill_yards.description: Sergeants turn recruits into soldiers sooner.

field_rations.name: Field Rations
field_rations.description: Salted meat and hard bread: your soldiers eat less.

siegecraft.name: Siegecraft
siegecraft.description: Carpenters learn to build siege tools quickly.

weaponsmiths.name: Weaponsmiths
weaponsmiths.description: Better steel: your attackers hit harder on the walls and in the courtyard.

forced_march.name: Forced March
forced_march.description: Scouts find the shortest roads: your armies march faster.

masonry.name: Masonry
masonry.description: Thicker mortar and deeper footings make your walls stronger.

militia.name: Militia Drill
militia.description: Your garrison drills daily and defends the walls and courtyard harder.

cellars.name: Hidden Cellars
cellars.description: Secret stores raiders never find: part of every resource is safe from plunder.

infirmary.name: Infirmary
infirmary.description: Healers tend the wounded: some defenders who fall come back after a battle at your castle.

murder_holes.name: Murder Holes
murder_holes.description: Openings above the gates and wall walks: room for one more defence tool on every wall per level.
